subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: Read and analyse a description of a tour in Istanbul
Use sequence words to order events
Design a tour for visitors to Oman

tf.s: Sultanahmet is the old part of Istanbul.
tf.why: Yes! The walking tour visits old Istanbul.

tf.s: The Sultanahmet walking tour starts at 9 a.m.
tf.why: Right! It starts in the morning.

tf.s: The walking tour starts at the Arasta Bazaar.
tf.why: The tour starts at Topkapi Palace.

tf.s: The Blue Mosque takes its name from the blue tiles on the inside of its walls.
tf.why: Correct! The tiles give it its name.

tf.s: The 'Istanbul by night' tour includes dinner and a show of traditional music.
tf.why: Yes! It is at a Turkish restaurant.

tf.s: You can find carpets, jewellery and ceramics in the Arasta Bazaar.
tf.why: Right! The bazaar sells many things.

tf.s: 'Finally' is used to start a sequence.
An itinerary is a plan or list of places you will visit on a journey.
A sanctuary is a busy market for tourists.
tf.why: A sanctuary is a protected area for animals or birds.

tf.s: 'Our final stop will be…' shows the first place on a tour.
tf.why: It shows the last place on the tour.

boxes.q: Where does the Sultanahmet tour start?
boxes.why: The tour begins at the palace.

boxes.q: What time does the Sultanahmet tour start?
boxes.why: It is a morning walking tour.

boxes.q: Which tour includes a show of traditional music?
Why is the Blue Mosque called 'blue'?
o: the blue tiles on its inside walls
boxes.why: The tiles give it its name.

boxes.q: Put in order: finally / first / then

o: a plan of places to visit
boxes.why: An itinerary lists your journey's stops.

boxes.q: Which phrase begins a tour description?
boxes.why: It tells visitors where the tour begins.

o: a protected area for animals or birds
boxes.why: Animals are safe in a sanctuary.

hunt.q: Start time of the walking tour
Plan of places on a journey

mcq.q: Name two reasons why people travel.
o: to relax and to learn about other cultures
to stay at home and sleep
mcq.why: Travel helps people relax and learn.

mcq.q: Which tour includes a visit to Topkapi Palace?
mcq.why: The walking tour starts at the palace.

mcq.q: Which of these is a sequence word?
mcq.why: Sequence words show the order of events.

o: a holiday where travel and hotel are arranged together
mcq.why: Package holidays include travel and accommodation.

mcq.q: Which phrase shows the order of places in the tour description?
o: From Topkapi, it is a short walk to…
mcq.why: 'From… it is a short walk to…' moves to the next place.

mcq.q: Correct: 'we will visit the fort then we go to the souq'.
o: We will visit the fort, then we will go to the souq.
we will visit the fort then we will go the souq
We visit the fort, then we went to the souq.
We will visit the fort then we goes to the souq.
mcq.why: Use a capital letter, a comma and the same future form.

mcq.q: Which is the best first sentence for a tour of Nizwa?
o: Our tour starts at Nizwa Fort at 9 a.m.
Our final stop will be the hotel.
mcq.why: Begin with where and when the tour starts.

mcq.q: Why does a tour description use phrases like 'Our final stop will be…'?
o: To show the order of places clearly
mcq.why: Sequence phrases help visitors follow the tour.

mcq.q: A visitor loves shopping for carpets and jewellery. Which part of the walking tour will they enjoy most?
mcq.why: The bazaar sells carpets, jewellery, pictures and ceramics.

mcq.q: Why does a good tour of Oman need an itinerary?
o: Visitors know which places they will see and in what order
mcq.why: An itinerary plans the journey clearly.
